title: Creamy Mushroom Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew made with tender mushrooms and a rich, creamy sauce. Perfect for a cold winter's night.

ingredients.name: mushroom
ingredients.notes: button or cremini mushrooms work well

ingredients.name: silky cream
ingredients.notes: heavy cream or half-and-half also work

instructions: In a large pot or Dutch oven, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the stew mix and cook according to package instructions.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Pour in the cream and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the stew has thickened slightly.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
